name: Trickster
notes: Core: same as Arbalester (Real Target -> Bleeding Shot -> Twin Shot, Rising Shot at 3+).

The Trickster table has no "older skills" row; the other Arbalester rows (Fast Shot, Sharpshooting, souls, Dark Armor, emergencies, upkeep, never, obsolete) are not repeated here (guide gap; the class 130 rows are the guide's rules for them).

rows.trig: Core: Fallen Arrow opener.
Core: Fallen Attack (rapier or sword).
Self-buff Rapid Attack (10+, +15% Atk.Spd): only without board Haste (slot conflict ATTACK_TIME_DOWN).
Never auto: Double Thrust (rapier).
rows.why: rapier skill; this path uses a crossbow

rows.trig: Never auto: Warp.
rows.why: blinks toward the facing direction

rows.trig: Never auto: Erase Mark (removes your own Death Mark).
rows.why: always-never list: removes Death Mark

rows.trig: Self-buff: Fast Shot lvl 2. Always.

when.text: only when stationary (party, boss, static pulls); never while kiting

rows.trig: Self-buff: Sharpshooting (60+, P.Atk/crit/accuracy/range up for 120 s, roots you). Only when stationary (party, boss, static pulls). Never while kiting.

when.text: not in combat, or the target HP is high

rows.trig: Use the global rules: auto-use when souls < 5 && HP > 70% && (not in combat || target HP high). Costs 193 to 328 HP for 1 to 5 souls, 11 s reuse, cannot be cast at 40 souls. (Arbalester self-buffs row: "Life to Soul / Soul Gathering: use the global rules")

when.text: before a pull or a raid; needs 10 Spirit Ore

rows.trig: Use the global rules: before a pull or a raid when souls < 10 and Spirit Ore (3031) >= 10. Gives +50 souls (capped), costs 10 Spirit Ore and 200 HP, 30 min reuse. (Arbalester self-buffs row: "Life to Soul / Soul Gathering: use the global rules")
Toggle: Dark Armor. Always on (owner rule: toggles only in fights).
Emergency: Soul Shock (fear). When a mob is in melee range (solo only; in a party fear scatters mobs).
Emergency: Ultimate Escape. When HP < 25%.
Emergency: Decoy (43+, summons a decoy, 10 min). When HP < 30% and a mob is on you.

when.text: I am hit by archers or mages

rows.trig: Emergency: Soul Barrier (58+). Vs archers or mages.
Emergency: Soul Cleanse (66+). When debuffed.

when.text: the tank is next to me

rows.trig: Emergency: Shift Target (40+, moves aggro to a party member). Only in a party, when a mob targets you and the tank is next to you.

rows.trig: Core: same as Arbalester: Real Target → Bleeding Shot → Twin Shot. Rising Shot at 3+. Real Target (900 range, bow/crossbow resist down, 30 s, 3 s reuse). On every non-trash target. Recast when it expires. Priority: Real Target (if missing) > Bleeding Shot (if no bleed) > Twin Shot > auto-attack.

Core: same as Arbalester: Real Target → Bleeding Shot → Twin Shot. Rising Shot at 3+. Bleeding Shot (43+, 8 s, bleed DoT) if no bleed. Priority: Real Target (if missing) > Bleeding Shot (if no bleed) > Twin Shot > auto-attack.

Core: same as Arbalester: Real Target → Bleeding Shot → Twin Shot. Rising Shot at 3+. Twin Shot (3 s, power 4870, main nuke). Priority: Real Target (if missing) > Bleeding Shot (if no bleed) > Twin Shot > auto-attack.
Core: same as Arbalester: Real Target → Bleeding Shot → Twin Shot. Rising Shot at 3+. Rising Shot (46+, AoE around the target, 6 s, 202 MP). Use at 3+ clustered. It is MP heavy, so keep MP > 30%.

Toggle: Focus Skill Mastery (78+, raises the Skill Mastery proc chance, MP drain −2). Boss or raid only. Off for farming. (unc)
Manual only (transform, 1 h reuse). Needs and uses 20 souls plus 200 HP; 5 min transform that doubles P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk and M.Def and replaces the skill bar.
